data.gender_notes: Odella is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Odos' meaning way and 'Elle' meaning God. This name signifies God's bounty or God's way. The name Odella carries the meaning “God's bounty” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Odella usually hope their child will grow to embody god's bounty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying God's divine guidance and blessings.
data.etymology: Odella belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's bounty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Odella total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
data.cultural_impact: The name Odella has a unique blend of Greek and Christian influences. The Greek origins of Odos and Elle suggest a connection to ancient Greece, where the name may have been used to honor the gods. However, in the context of Christianity, this name takes on a new meaning, representing the concept of God's divine path or way in our lives.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Odella lies in its meaning of "God's way." This name reminds us of the importance of trusting in God's plan for our lives and following His lead. It encourages us to have faith in His guidance and to walk in His way, knowing that He is always with us and will bring us to our ultimate destination. Odella is a beautiful reminder of the comfort and security found in God's plan for our lives.
